what: Hundreds of silhouette pieces — hands, leaves, flowers, birds, fish, houses, trees, music notes (a gradient between two accent colors) — fill the board, leaving the center ellipse (the text area) empty, and each piece is turned to face outward. On burst, the pieces grow in .7s back.out near the center and toward the camera (250 + distance×.5), then fly to their places with a .35~.85s delay by distance over 2s expo.inOut, while the whole board backs off to .95x over 3s. Settled pieces each sway (±.05 rad), and when the mouse moves faster than 100px per second, a wave spreading half a turn to both sides from that angle in .25s flips the pieces it passes on the x axis and returns them over 1.5s sine.in. Pressing flips them all together by .75, and scrolling scatters pieces upward by about 500px while fading them (follow .1).

options.on: load (default — bursts as soon as attached) · signal (bursts when the element receives an fx:burst event — for bursting after the loading curtain)
options.step: Piece spacing (per panel), default 70 — smaller is denser
options.rx · ry · cy: Center ellipse radius and vertical position to leave empty (in panel units), default 430 · 225 · 10
options.scale: Plate unit → screen px multiplier, default window width under 600 .54 · 959 or less 1 · above that 1.203 (original value)
options.wave: if off, turns off the mouse ripple
options.scroll: If off, it does not scatter on scroll
options.dist: Scroll distance (px) over which the panel fully scatters once pinned to the screen, default viewport height
options.--fx-piece-a · --fx-piece-b: Two gradient colors, default accent · the accent mixed toward the text color
options.--fx-burst: Scatter amount (0~1) the part writes onto the board — read in css when the center text is pushed up together

from.where: index.html .ps-mv (hero — original three r148: piece aq.show burst position z 250+.5s·.7s back.out·2s expo.inOut·delay .5×easeInOut(s/1000)+.35, aY.update sway · flip-follow .075 · setPower 1.5s sine.in, ripple se angle .25·.25s sine.out (every .1s when speed exceeds 100px/s), on press setPower(.75), scroll = scrollY ÷ business section position·follow .1, board scale .54·1·1.203)

note: The original sprite pngs and hand-placed coordinates are not used, our 17 silhouettes are drawn on canvas and laid across the whole panel in a jittered grid. In the original, the pieces that made up the logo burst out in place, but here all parts burst near the center (the site keeps the logo group separately). Press and ripple do not block page scroll
